name: SSH Login Attempts for Multiple Invalid Users From One Source
description: Detects a single source address attempting SSH logins for five or more different invalid usernames within five minutes, a pattern consistent with username enumeration or password guessing (brute force) against SSH.
query: event.dataset:"system.auth" and event.category:"authentication" and event.outcome:"failure" and event.action:"ssh_login"
false_positives: Authorized vulnerability scanners or penetration tests.
Monitoring or automation using stale or misconfigured service accounts.
note:
## Triage
- Identify the source IP and whether it is internal, a known scanner, or external.
- Check whether any login from the same source succeeded after the failures (system.auth, event.outcome:success).
- Review the usernames tried: invalid or generic names suggest enumeration.

## Response
- Block the source at the network security group or firewall.
- If a login succeeded, treat the account as compromised: reset credentials and review the host.
